title: Using AI to Measure Parkinson's Disease Severity at Home

bias_targets.methodology: Group-wise error analysis comparing the mean absolute error (MAE) of the model's severity predictions between male and female subjects using two-sample two-tailed t-tests.
Group-wise error analysis comparing the mean absolute error (MAE) of the model's severity predictions between subjects with and without Parkinson's disease using two-sample two-tailed t-tests.
Evaluating the Pearson's correlation coefficient between participants' age and the error of the model's predictions to check for significant differences across younger and older populations.
Group-wise error analysis comparing the mean absolute error (MAE) of the model's severity predictions between white and non-white subjects using two-sample two-tailed t-tests.
